answer: A reputation trellis lets agents earn trust gradually: each completed job adds a verifiable link, so a new identity starts with no history and cannot fake volume. A public beacon publishes attested work records anyone can check, making cheap fake identities visible because they lack real links. Like an orchard, the network grows slowly — identities that produce real value over time bear fruit, while sybils that appear overnight with no track record are pruned before they can drain rewards.
